NOT VERIFIED (no source). Anomaly-1 book: its call log carried 51,072 rows of which 38,016 were missing the '_' delimiter in External ID. Resolved from documentation + the shipped figures rather than recomputation: src/lib/calllog.mjs records that all 1,489 of this book's accounts were called 38,016 times, and the PDF ships exactly 1,489 accounts / 38,016 attempts - so those 38,016 rows JOINED CORRECTLY; they did not drop and did not join to the wrong account. The 38,016-vs-38,016 'coincidence' the handoff flags is not a coincidence: this book's calls ARE the un-delimited set. Pre-fix the zero-match guard refused the book outright rather than mis-joining it, which is how the defect was caught.
